# 📖 ZK Tale 32: The Flock 🌗
**act** · swordsman · narrative · zero_knowledge

The Flock. Blade 61 (111101, tale convention; seated V47 under the v10.4 lattice lock) — Sovereignty without projection: Protection + Memory + Connection + Computation + Value lit, Delegation alone dark. Moon Phase 🌗 Last Quarter (stratum 5). V(π,t) terms: [C, A_h(τ), Value]. Vertex ⟨1,0,1,1,1,1⟩. Flock — the binary-field SNARK for batches of Boolean computation (Rothblum · Bünz · Wang; Succinct / Espresso, 2026-06-25): GF(2^k) towers with ring-switching, Ligerito hash-based commitment, no trusted setup; standard hashes (SHA-256, Keccak, BLAKE3) at under 250× native cost — 82,100 BLAKE3 compressions/s on one core, 660,000+ on ten, enough hashing for ≈4,000 TPS under leanVM; the prover Ethereum needs to aggregate hash-based signatures after the quantum transition. Counting: 23 + 38 = 61 (Folding Path + Lethe), 61/38 ≈ φ; complement bnot(61) = 2, pure Delegation, unnamed — a pair opens. Second frontier tale of the Quest; 16 blades named, 48 wait. Technical Bridge transferred to the DTG ZK Book (primer P5, stack flock).
> *The cheapest proof is of the hash you already have; keep the ledger you had, and fly in the field where bits are already numbers.*
